name: Brask Ode
lore: Brask knows which wrecks still bite and which can be stripped clean. He guards the salvage lanes with a patient eye for machinery, hazards, and one last useful haul.

abilities.name: Salvage Right
abilities.text: Once per round, after resolving Hollow Veil Sweep, gain 1 Salvage and recover Coffin Rig. Equip it if your Armor slot is empty.

abilities.name: Scrap Bastion
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Forge on yellow Hazard tests or tests in salvage sectors.

abilities.name: Last Haul
abilities.text: Once per round, after you Stabilize, ready one exhausted Gear you own.
